Biosolids are managed in two aerobic digesters, dewatered by a two-meter belt press, and stockpiled in a sludge holding bed. The holding bed contains drains which permit leachate to flow back to the head of the liquid treatment train for treatment.

Biosolids are periodically removed and hauled by Liberty Composting to its 162-acre composting facility in Kern County, California. The Discharger composts approximately 100 tons of biosolids per year.
